palindrome:
Able was I ere I saw Elba. That's a famous palindrome, but it's only 23 characters long. To create a longer one, we could add more words and phrases that form palindromes when combined:

Able was I ere I saw Elba.
Able was I ere I saw Elba. No, sir, I'm Adam, madam, I'm Adam.

This palindrome is 115 characters long and contains two separate palindromic phrases.
